candidates.priority_score_mechanism: 以加一H或成组M的完整摧毁概率增量配置余量，统一H天眼窗，L三机首批

runtime: per-unit current task and native command receipts
forbidden: Q label as a policy selector
private hidden target catalogue or HP
legal_inputs.coordinate_contract: Original unscaled lon/lat/alt in actions; WGS84 ECEF for distances. No model-scale multiplication in actor output. Targets at z=0; deployments at 3000m.

deployment.algorithm: Use all polygon boundaries (41samples/edge) and legal11x11 interior samples, then solve exact desired-distance edge roots. Choose point minimizing ETA error plus soft350m separation penalty; altitude3000. All points validated in the relevant polygon union. H nominal200,M120,L100m/s. Same target H arrival jitter4s, M jitter5s. No waiting or relaunch.

parameters.name: 完整摧毁边际预算
parameters.mechanism: 以加一H或成组M的完整摧毁概率增量配置余量，统一H天眼窗，L三机首批

ordinary_conditions: 9400 robust order-free lower bound:9.6H+2.4M>=24. This is deliberately conservative: the first hit without history has no decrease.
For 2 H alone on a mother, first>=16 and second>=9.6 gives25.6 if both hit; no H-loss margin. With arbitrary M arrival order the generic all-hit floor remains safe.
9600 H+2M=18 but loses completeness after any member loss;2H=24 survives no H loss.
window_conditions: 9400 2H=40 intact;1H+2M has worst20+4.8=24.8. 2H+2M keeps24.8 after losing oneH if the remainingH hits during window.
9600 1H=20 intact,2H=40 keeps20 after oneH loss;1H+6M keeps18 after oneH loss.
L batch3/4/5 gives2.4/3.2/4.0 intact damage, not guaranteed destruction because hiddenHP is unknown.
public_target_assignment.loss_model: Exact enumeration over independent assumed H/M survival in _p_kill; these are hypothesis parameters, not measured or official probabilities. No artificial survival reward; objective is target weight times estimated full-kill probability plus explicit fallback robustness.
public_target_assignment.allocation_algorithm: Seed each public mother with2H, each sentry with1H. When infeasible select complete packages in weight/(1+nearestETA/1000) order. Spend all remaining H/M by enumerating bundle increments dH=0..2,dM=0..8; maximize weighted complete-kill objective gain divided by dH*(M_inventory/H_inventory)+dM. Tie-break gain, cost, ETA, target ref. Includes ordinary-angle fallback; compile outputs actual budgets after geometry and escort placement.

arrival_coordination.window_search: Enumerate start times every5s, evaluate legal per-target H ETA intervals; score weighted target inclusion in inner[+12,+168]s minus delay penalty; aim at candidate arrival_fraction*180. Candidate-specific sentry/deep/mother/early/late objective is executable in planner.
arrival_coordination.uncertainty: ±45s reported estimate, not a native guarantee. Target movement12m/s, V13 interference and stage-dependent flight can dominate.
arrival_coordination.M_late_handling: Deploy M as close as legally possible if desired ETA cannot be met. Report M-lastH gap. A06 moves oneH per eligible multi-H target toward M ETA as sensor escort. Other plans budget H complete kill independently and treat M as uncertain backup; no unsupported target-death assumption.
arrival_coordination.same_target_updates: Attack IDs reissued each step; coordinates from latest legal records only. Fresh H observations near target can update nearby M.
arrival_coordination.angles: No claimed guaranteed >30degree bonus or avoided<10degree penalty. Soft alternation of deployment side is a diversity tie-break only; budgets retain conservative factors.

satellite_policy.optimization: combine H complete-budget arrival coverage with early hidden-discovery opportunity; report predicted coverage and post-discovery L reachability per case
satellite_policy.responsibility: central-latitude rear-search L first; statically ordered otherL backups every3s, rank slots capped45s; any available issuer type is legal, but these plans choose L to preserve attack commitment
satellite_policy.trigger: planned time or primary advance<=18s when >=60% and >=2 own-group H legally observed ETA<=22s; no cross-group adaptive observations
satellite_policy.activity: use legal is_using_satellite flag; observed active latches only local memory. Unit request marker prevents same-unit retry after split. Other groups may attempt backup; engine quota handles global competition.
satellite_policy.failure: late requests stop at min(1150,planned+45); if none succeed, use ordinary-budget fallback without inventing another opportunity

search_and_hidden_targets.geometry: full north-south map span divided into ceil(height/spacing) horizontal lanes; actual lane step<=profile spacing. Every L assigned lane i%nlanes, wave floor(i/nlanes). Rear wave starts near legal western edge, forward waves near eastern legal edge with1800m spacing. Projection considers all polygons.

search_and_hidden_targets.route: first leg to east map edge400m inset; optional broad return to lane+2 and western waypoint, switch8km early only with45s turning and90s remaining margin. First-leg coverage only is credited in static estimates.
search_and_hidden_targets.hidden_hp: unknown; batch damage is a budget, not kill guarantee
search_and_hidden_targets.dispatch: sort by nearest ETA except early/deep profiles use smallest remaining-lifetime slack; choose a compact arrival wave within hidden_spread seconds, preserve search floor, compare current actual bindings before every nomination
search_and_hidden_targets.knowledge: static targets can retain old coordinates for existing commitment; new assignments and replenishment require fresh timestamp<=6s; absent snapshot is unknown, never dead
search_and_hidden_targets.insufficient: wait for complete batch until1450s, then allow reachable partial final wave; all members still require remaining-life margin

public_target_assignment.loss_model: Exact enumeration over independent assumed H/M survival in _p_kill; these are hypothesis parameters, not measured or official probabilities. No artificial survival reward; objective is target weight times estimated full-kill probability plus explicit fallback robustness.
public_target_assignment.allocation_algorithm: Seed each public mother with2H, each sentry with1H. When infeasible select complete packages in weight/(1+nearestETA/1000) order.
